## Sharetec Systems - Senior Full Stack Software Engineer

🔗 [Apply](https://recruiting.paylocity.com/Recruiting/Jobs/Details/4542466)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior Full Stack Software Engineer modernizing full-stack banking and lending software for credit unions. Leading architecture, development, mentoring, and production reliability.
Senior Full Stack Software Engineer modernizing banking and lending software for credit unions
- Salary: $110,000 - $140,000 per year
- Tech stack: Angular, Cloud, Distributed Systems, Docker, Java, JavaScript, Kubernetes, MongoDB, Node.js, Postgres, Python, React, Spring, Spring Boot, SpringBoot, SQL, Vue.js, .NET
- Architect scalable, secure, and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, and database layers
- Lead design discussions, code reviews, and engineering best-practice initiatives
- Evaluate new technologies and guide adoption of tools that improve developer productivity and system performance
- Define and document architecture patterns, design principles, and shared libraries for reuse across teams
- Partner with DevOps on CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and observability tooling
- Build high-quality, production-ready features using modern frameworks and cloud platforms
- Write clean, testable, and efficient code, and help coding standards evolve
- Optimize system performance, reduce technical debt, and improve reliability
- 6+ years of professional software development experience, including technical leadership on complex projects
- Deep proficiency with at least one backend platform: C#/.NET, Java/Spring Boot, Node.js, OpenEdge, or Python/FastAPI
- Advanced experience with modern frontend technologies: Angular, React, or Vue.js
- Strong database design and data architecture expertise: Progress, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or MongoDB
- Experience integrating APIs and third-party systems securely and efficiently
- Proven ability to modernize legacy applications into modular designs
- Familiarity with DevOps tooling, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud services
- Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and performance optimization

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Full Stack Software Engineer modernizing full-stack banking and lending software for credit unions. Leading architecture, development, mentoring, and production reliability.
Senior Full Stack Software Engineer modernizing banking and lending software for credit unions
Role description:
• Architect scalable, secure, and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, and database layers
• Lead design discussions, code reviews, and engineering best-practice initiatives
• Evaluate new technologies and guide adoption of tools that improve developer productivity and system performance
• Define and document architecture patterns, design principles, and shared libraries for reuse across teams
• Partner with DevOps on CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and observability tooling
• Build high-quality, production-ready features using modern frameworks and cloud platforms
• Write clean, testable, and efficient code, and help coding standards evolve
• Optimize system performance, reduce technical debt, and improve reliability
• Work with QA engineers on automated testing strategies and code coverage
• Participate in the production support rotation and lead root cause analysis and prevention
• Mentor and coach mid-level and junior engineers
• Partner with product managers and stakeholders to translate business needs into technical solutions
• Give feedback and guidance during design and implementation reviews
• Act as a technical resource and subject matter expert for the product domain
Role requirements:
• 6+ years of professional software development experience, including technical leadership on complex projects
• Deep proficiency with at least one backend platform: C#/.NET, Java/Spring Boot, Node.js, OpenEdge, or Python/FastAPI
• Advanced experience with modern frontend technologies: Angular, React, or Vue.js
• Strong database design and data architecture expertise: Progress, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or MongoDB
• Experience integrating APIs and third-party systems securely and efficiently
• Proven ability to modernize legacy applications into modular designs
• Familiarity with DevOps tooling, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud services
• Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and performance optimization
• Clear communication skills for explaining complex technical ideas to varied audiences
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
• Preferred: Experience leading small teams or serving as technical lead on a feature squad
• Preferred: Experience designing distributed systems or microservice architectures
• Preferred: Hands-on experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
• Preferred: Security-first mindset and experience implementing secure coding practices
• Preferred: Prior experience in financial services or fintech
• Preferred: Familiarity with SOC 2 or other compliance frameworks
Benefits:
• Competitive salaries
• Medical coverage
• Dental coverage
• Vision coverage
• Life coverage
• Disability coverage
• Generous Paid Time Off (PTO)
• Paid holidays, including your birthday off
• $1,000 employee referral program
• 401(k) with company matching
• Virtual events
• Collaborative team experiences
• Regular all-hands meetings
Tech stack:
Angular, Cloud, Distributed Systems, Docker, Java, JavaScript, Kubernetes, MongoDB, Node.js, Postgres, Python, React, Spring, Spring Boot, SpringBoot, SQL, Vue.js, .NET
